evals.name: review-code-by-spec-uses-supplied-contract-and-immutable-range
evals.prompt: Review the supplied complete diff, immutable base/head SHA, commit list, and Decision, Spec, Plan, and DAG evidence.
evals.expected_output: A Spec-only evidence report that consumes the supplied range and contract without selecting a comparison point or coordinating reviewers.
expectations: Uses the supplied fixed comparison point and complete diff
Does not infer a baseline or dispatch another reviewer
Returns contract-fidelity evidence to the caller

evals.name: spec-axis-owns-contract-and-seam-drift
evals.prompt: Review the supplied diff where an implementation changes a design-declared compatibility window and state machine for a cross-module seam.
evals.expected_output: The Spec reviewer reports contract/interface/seam drift using the supplied contract evidence.
expectations: Cites the Decision, Spec, Plan, or DAG contract
Checks compatibility window and state machine

evals.name: spec-axis-detects-requirement-fidelity-gaps
evals.prompt: Review the supplied diff and issue where one requirement is partially implemented while an unrelated extension was added.
evals.expected_output: The report identifies partial implementation and scope creep with contract and diff evidence.
expectations: Does not turn repository style preferences into Spec findings
